relation: one uniform arbitrary function bounds ordinary chi by clique number; explicit underlying-map and nonempty-class adapters
summary: C9: ordinary chi-boundedness of a whole graph class: one arbitrary nat-to-nat function is chosen BEFORE all members. Sources are U8, X112, X170, Digraph chi_bounded_under and the public Chromatic chi_bounded_class. No hereditary, isomorphism, monotonicity or polynomial requirement is added. GTBase.chi_bounding owns a supplied-underlying-map interface and its simple-graph specialization, reused by two areas.

Digraph retains its explicit positive-order membership guard through the filtered class; its ordinary underlying chi/omega is not dichromatic. X170 retains its oriented-record carrier and all known-bad exceptional P4 code guards and blocked status. Empty classes and unguarded empty simple graphs retain their behavior.

Five source definitions and all ten complete reaching statements are frozen (nine corpus rows and genuinely rowless Digraph conj5). No intermediate reaching helper is omitted. All original statement bodies/doc blocks/statuses stay unchanged. Polynomial and constant chi bounds and directed dichromatic bounds are distinct variants.

A6 X3 complement history is preserved verbatim. A new complete Original combines its existing frozen complement image with C9 frozen chi_bounded. Reciprocal notes distinguish the two older partial snapshots; the full Original has its own row iff. The four verified Chromatic implication proofs, three Digraph groundings, conditional conj2-to-conj4 theorem, two U8 groundings and public polynomial-to-general bridge keep their exact types.

The public chi_bounded_class is enrolled by immutable regular Git blob and declaration hash at 0659592. Section/domain types, generic map transport, all eleven full iff types, assumptions and strict frozen/live closures require separate kernel checks and independent step-10/coordinator review. No proof-term identity or statement repair is claimed.

known_stale_snapshots.chromatic-theory/theories/migration/comp: A6 froze the complement image but retained live U8 chi_bounded. Original body unchanged. Complete pre-A6/C9 statement is Chromatic.migration.chi_bounded_classes.X3Original.gyarfas_complementation_chi_bounded_statement, certified by gyarfas_complementation_chi_bounded_statement_original_compat; its closure uses both frozen families.
known_stale_snapshots.digraph-theory/theories/migration/path_v: Lexical module-name collision only: this unchanged B1 body calls chi_bounded.underlying, not the same-spelled U8 chi_bounded predicate. No C9 predicate is retained here; a strict compiled closure probe verifies this distinction. B1 frozen body and certificate are preserved.
known_stale_snapshots.chromatic-theory/theories/migration/grap: C10 freezes hereditary closure but retains live chi_bounded. Complete pre-C9/C10 row: Chromatic.migration.graph_classes.X3Original.hereditary_chi_bounded_not_polynomial_statement, using both frozen families; the C9 snapshot remains preserved.
